title: Black Box Q2 profit rises 30.6% to ₹72.6 crore; revenue up 22.2%
content:

The Mumbai-headquartered company had posted a net profit of Rs 55.65 crore in the year-ago period, according to a regulatory filing by the company.

Growth was driven by execution across hyperscale data centre infrastructure and enterprise solutions, supported by growing momentum in its technology products business, the company said in a statement.

title: India imports over half its edible oil, faces food risks: NITI Aayog VC
content:
India is perhaps still not secure regarding its food supply across the various products, as the country is the world's largest importer of edible oils, NITI Aayog vice-chairman Ashok Kumar Lahiri said on Friday.
Addressing an event here, Lahiri said India meets more than half of its edible oil needs through imports, and imports are estimated at 17 million metric tonnes, valued at about USD 20 billion.
Similarly, India is both the world's largest producer and consumer of pulses, and accounts for roughly a fourth of total global pulse consumption, approximately 25 to 27 million tonnes annually.
"We are talking about Viksit Krishi in Viksit Bharat in 2047. As we move towards Viksit Bharat at 2047, are we secure regarding our food supply across the various products? Perhaps not as yet," he said.

title: BPCL says E20 petrol meets quality standards, clarifies viral test image
content:
Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL) on Friday sought to dispel concerns over the ethanol content of E20 petrol, saying a photograph circulating on social media from a fuel-quality demonstration in Karnataka was captured before the testing process had been completed and did not represent the final test result.
Clarifying the controversy, the state-owned oil marketing company in a statement said the image showed an intermediate stage of an ethanol separation test, in which the mixture of petrol and water initially turns hazy or milky before the two layers separate completely.
The photograph was inadvertently shared before the separation process was complete, following which the officer concerned promptly removed the post to prevent misinterpretation, BPCL said. The sample tested was found to be within prescribed specifications, it added.

title: Bengal draft voter list on Nov 23, final electoral rolls on Jan 16
content:
The Election Commission will publish the draft electoral rolls for West Bengal on November 23, with the final voters' list scheduled to be released on January 16, 2027, as part of a Special Summary Revision (SSR), a statement said on Friday.
The revision will be conducted with January 1, 2027, as the qualifying date, allowing those who turn 18 by then to enrol as voters, it said.
According to the schedule announced by the Chief Electoral Officer's (CEO) office, electors can submit claims and objections between November 23 and December 22. The disposal of applications will be completed by January 8.
Special campaign days will be held at designated polling stations across the state on November 28 and 29, and December 5, 6, 12, 13, 19 and 20 to facilitate public participation, the statement said.
Booth Level Officers (BLOs) will be available at polling stations on these days to assist voters with fresh enrolment, correction of particulars and submission of claims and objections.

title: India's forex reserves rise by $2.49 billion to $719.55 billion: RBI data
content:
India's forex reserves increased by USD 2.49 billion to USD 719.547 billion during the week ended November 6, according to the RBI data released on Friday.
In the previous week, the forex reserves had dropped by USD 2.691 billion to USD 717.056 billion.
The reserves had touched an all-time high of USD 785.706 billion during the week ended September 4, driven by a heavy flow of currency as part of a special concessional swap for deposits from the diaspora through which banks raised a record USD 133 billion, but had been on a decline ever since.
During the week ended November 6, foreign currency assets, a major component of reserves, increased by USD 232 million to USD 591.350 billion, according to the data released by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).
Expressed in dollar terms, the foreign currency assets include effects of appreciation or depreciation of non-US units, such as the euro, pound, and yen, held in foreign exchange reserves.

content:

Total income increased to Rs 2,602 crore in the second quarter of FY27, compared to Rs 1,900 crore in the year-ago period, Edelweiss Financial Services said in a regulatory filing.

The company completed the Rs 1,200-crore IPO of its subsidiary Edelweiss Alternatives last month.
Earlier this year, global investment management firm Carlyle became a strategic majority investor in another subsidiary of the company, Nido Home Finance, with an investment of Rs 2,000 crore.

title: Tata Sons rejects Noel Tata's request for Sept 17 board meeting recording

Noel, the only dissenter on the vote for the reappointment, had sought the recordings through a series of communications to Tata Sons since the board meeting, which brought out the differences between the top echelons of the salt-to-software group, with the management of Tata Sons on one side and its biggest shareholder on the other.
"Video recording is mandated when one or more Directors attend online.  Company has never in the past had a practice of sharing audio/ video recording of in-person meeting," Tata Sons' company secretary Suprakash Mukhopadhyay wrote to Tata Trusts on November 9.

Its revenue from operations declined to Rs 967.3 crore in the second quarter of FY27 from Rs 1,363 crore a year ago, the company said in a regulatory filing.
Total expenses stood at Rs 776.2 crore, down from Rs 849.3 crore a year ago, it said.
During the quarter, Natco acquired an additional 13.25 per cent stake in Adcock Ingram Holding Ltd.
In the first half of the current fiscal (H1 FY27), Natco Pharma posted a 59 per cent decline in net profit to Rs 409.1 crore from Rs 998.2 crore in the April-September period of the preceding financial year.
The company's board of directors also approved an interim dividend of Rs 1.25 per equity share of Rs 2 each during the quarter under review.

title: Delhi to deploy over 5,000 police personnel for Chhath Puja celebrations
content:
Security will be beefed up in Delhi for Chhath celebrations on November 15 and 16, with the deployment of more than 5,000 police personnel, police said.
Security arrangements will be particularly strengthened around the Yamuna ghats, ponds, and locations where large gatherings are expected.
Special attention will be given to areas in the East, Northeast, and Shahdara districts, where a large number of devotees are expected to assemble to perform religious rituals.
All district deputy commissioners of police have held meetings with Chhath Puja organisers and members of local committees to discuss security arrangements and crowd management, a senior officer said.
Patrols will be carried out on foot, in PCR cars, and on motorbikes across the national capital.
Special emphasis will be laid on maintaining law and order during the evening prayers on November 15 and the morning rituals on November 16, when a large number of devotees are expected to visit the ghats.

title: Allahabad HC flags indefinite freezing of bank accounts after cyber fraud
content:
The Allahabad High Court has expressed serious concern over indefinite freezing of bank accounts of people after their identities and personal details are misused by cybercriminals.
A Lucknow bench of justices Rajan Roy and Subhash Vidyarthi on Thursday asked the Centre to devise an effective mechanism to address such cases, observing that gullible citizens should not be left trapped in the aftermath of cybercrimes committed using their details.
The bench impleaded the home ministry in a petition filed by a builder whose bank accounts have remained frozen.
It directed Deputy Solicitor General SB Pandey, appearing for the Union government, to obtain instructions and file an affidavit in response.
The matter will be heard after four weeks.

title: PM Modi inaugurates Bengaluru Metro's Pink Line, travels with CM Shivakumar
content:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Friday inaugurated the much-awaited Pink Line from Kalena Agrahara to Tavarekere of the Metro Rail project here, built at a cost of around Rs 3,470 crore.
PM Modi and Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar together flagged off the new services and travelled on the Metro train. Modi and Shivakumar were also seen buying separate tickets from the counter.
The chief minister explained to the PM about the advantage of a double-decker elevated corridor having a metro rail line as well as a flyover to ease traffic congestion in the city.
Governor Sudha Yadav, MP Tejasvi Surya and Minister K B Gowda also travelled in the Metro train.
The total length of the Pink Line is 21.25 km, comprising 18 stations. While the elevated corridor, which the prime minister inaugurated, has six stations, the underground section will have 12 stations and is still under construction.
